USAspending API v2 bulk download, fetched 2026-09-22; FY2016. The 273,026 competed awards carrying a usable bid count and a parent_award_id_piid, 67.9% of competed awards; the rest name
no parent and are excluded. CAVEAT: vehicle identity is the PIID as filed and is not normalised, which understates the extremes rather than creating them. These eleven civilian
departments are 8.5% of federal contract awards; Defense (68.6%) is absent, so this is not federal procurement as a whole.
